propositions: Search command returns full ticket bodies including complete descriptions and all comments, producing 203+ KB output that exhausts discovery context; default projection should omit bodies and return only ticket_id, alias, title, ticket_type, status, priority, summary, and snippet

Search results lack a summary field; a new summary is derived from stored summary or normalized/truncated description (max 240 chars) or null if both absent/empty, while snippets are extracted from first matching free-text term case-insensitively and bounded to 240 chars with ellipsis

Search command rejects --output flag as unknown rather than recognizing json and llm formats; --output json emits canonical search_result.schema.json, --output llm emits search_result_llm.schema.json with minified keys and null-stripping, and --full returns legacy TicketState array

Snippet extraction must locate and contextualize the first matching positive free-text term across title/description/tags/id/alias/Jira/comments using a parallel case-preserving and lowercased search string, with bounded context from the field containing the match and no full body/comment exposure
Predicate-only and negation-only queries return null snippets; --full --output=llm is rejected as incompatible; MCP search advertises search_result.schema.json while show returns full TicketState
Live search output must reduce from 203 KB to under 25 KB for equivalent queries through projection and truncation.
